message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charge for the given fact: Liu Moujia carried fire paper, lighter to a village to worship ancestors, burned fire paper, caused forest fire, 99.1 mu forest area burned. He let relatives call police, tried to extinguish, then police caught him.

This is a case of arson (setting fire) causing forest fire. The list includes "放火" (arson) and also "危险物品肇事" (dangerous goods accident) but not relevant. The appropriate charge is "放火". Also possibly "过失以危险方法危害公共安全"? He unintentionally caused fire due to negligence. The fact says he burned fire paper and caused forest fire unintentionally. In Chinese criminal law, causing forest fire by negligence is "过失以危险方法危害公共安全" (negligent dangerous method endangering public safety) or "放火" (arson) if intentional. Since he didn't intend to set fire, it's negligence. The description: "因烧火冥纸不慎将山林引燃" (carelessly set fire). So the charge is "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". However the list includes "放火" as a charge for intentional arson. The examples: earlier they had "爆炸" for cases with gas cylinder and lighter, "放火" for case where someone set fire to house. In that case they intentionally set fire. Here it's accidental. The list includes "过失以危险方法危害公共安全". That seems appropriate.

Thus final answer: [罪名]过失以危险方法危害公共安全<eoa>
